content.title: AI stock rally: OpenAI valuation lifts Nvidia, AMD, Intel & more
content.description:
OpenAI's (OPAI.PVT) valuation has soared to $500 billion, according to The Wall Street Journal and other sources, replacing Elon Musk's SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) as the most valuable startup. This bullish artificial intelligence (AI) news is sending stocks like Samsung (005930.KS), AMD (AMD), Super Micro Computer (SMCI), and Nvidia (NVDA) higher on Thursday.

Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma outlines the details.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Morning Brief.
